e: And Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:
This shall be the law regarding the person with tzoraas [’confinement’]
on the day of his purification,
he shall be brought to the kohein.
The kohein shall go out
beyond the encampment.
The kohein shall see;
and behold! the skin-eruption of tzoraas [’confinement’] has healed from the person with tzoraas [’confinement’].

t: וְיִסַּב לְמִדַּכֵּי תַּרְתֵּין צִפְּרִין חַיִּין דָּכְיָן
e: The kohein shall command
to take for the person undergoing purification two live, pure [kosher] birds,
cedar wood,
crimson [colored] thread and hyssop.
The kohein shall command
to slaughter the one bird
in an earthenware vessel, over running water.

h: וְטָבַ֨ל אוֹתָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽחַיָּ֗ה בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַשְּׁחֻטָ֔ה
t: וְיָת אָעָא דְאַרְזָא וְיָת צְבַע זְהוֹרִי וְיָת אֵזוֹבָא
וְיִטְבּוֹל יָתְהוֹן וְיָת צִפְּרָא חַיְתָא בִּדְמָא דְּצִפְּרָא דִּנְכִיסָא
e: [As for] the living bird, he shall take it;
and the cedar wood, the crimson [colored] thread and the hyssop
and immerse them and the live bird in the blood of the slaughtered bird,
over the running water.

h: וְהִזָּ֗ה עַ֧ל הַמִּטַּהֵ֛ר מִן־הַצָּרַ֖עַת שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים
וְטִ֣הֲר֔וֹ וְשִׁלַּ֛ח אֶת־הַצִּפֹּ֥ר הַֽחַיָּ֖ה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
t: וְיַדִּי עַל דְּמִדַּכֵּי מִן סְגִירוּתָא שְׁבַע זִמְנִין
וִידַכִּנֵּיהּ וִישַׁלַּח יָת צִפְּרָא חַיְתָא עַל אַפֵּי חַקְלָא:
e: He shall sprinkle on the person undergoing purification from the tzoraas [’confinement’], seven times
and make him pure; and send the live bird into the open field.

h: וְכִבֶּס֩ הַמִּטַּהֵ֨ר אֶת־בְּגָדָ֜יו וְגִלַּ֣ח אֶת־כָּל־שְׂעָר֗וֹ וְרָחַ֤ץ בַּמַּ֙יִם֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר
t: וִיצַבַּע דְּמִדַּכֵּי יָת לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וִיגַלַּח יָת כָּל שַׂעֲרֵיהּ וְיַסְחֵי בְמַיָּא וְיִדְכֵּי
e: The person undergoing purification shall wash his garments, and shave off all of his hair, and bathe in water, and he will become purified.
After [this], he may come into the encampment.
He must remain, outside of his tent, for seven days.

h: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י יְגַלַּ֣ח אֶת־כָּל־שְׂעָר֗וֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֤וֹ וְאֶת־זְקָנוֹ֙ וְאֵת֙ גַּבֹּ֣ת עֵינָ֔יו
וְכִבֶּ֣ס אֶת־בְּגָדָ֗יו וְרָחַ֧ץ אֶת־בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָהֵֽר׃
t: וִיהֵי בְיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה יְגַלַּח יָת כָּל שַׂעֲרֵיהּ יָת רֵישֵׁיהּ וְיָת דִּקְנֵיהּ וְיָת גְּבִינֵי עֵינוֹהִי
וִיצַבַּע יָת לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיַסְחֵי יָת בִּסְרֵיהּ בְּמַיָּא וְיִדְכֵּי:
e: It shall be, that on the seventh day, he shall shave off all of his hair, [that of] his head, his beard and his eyebrows;
he shall shave off all of his hair.
He shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water and become purified.

h: וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן
t: וּבְיוֹמָא תְמִינָאָה יִסַּב תְּרֵין אִמְּרִין שַׁלְמִין
וּתְלָתָא עֶסְרוֹנִין סֻלְתָּא מִנְחָתָא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח
e: On the eighth day, he shall take two unblemished lambs
and one ewe in her first year, unblemished,
and three tenths fine flour, for a meal-offering, mixed with oil
and one log of oil.

h: וְהֶעֱמִ֞יד הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַֽמְטַהֵ֗ר אֵ֛ת הָאִ֥ישׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר וְאֹתָ֑ם
t: וִיקִים כַּהֲנָא דִמְדַּכֵּי יָת גַּבְרָא דְּמִדַּכֵּי וְיָתְהוֹן
e: The kohein doing the purification, shall place the man undergoing the purification and the [aforementioned] items,
before Adonoy,
at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

h: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֗ד וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹת֛וֹ לְאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת־לֹ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן
t: וְיִסַּב כַּהֲנָא יָת אִמְּרָא חֲדָא וִיקָרֵב יָתֵיהּ לַאֲשָׁמָא וְיָת לֻגָּא דְמִשְׁחָא
e: The kohein shall take one lamb and bring it as a guilt-offering, and (with) the log of oil
and wave [lift] them [up] as a wave-offering [an uplifted offering] before Adonoy.

h: וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֶת־הַכֶּ֗בֶשׂ בִּ֠מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחַ֧ט אֶת־הַֽחַטָּ֛את וְאֶת־הָעֹלָ֖ה בִּמְק֣וֹם הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ
t: וְיִכּוֹס יָת אִמְּרָא בַּאֲתַר דִּי יִכּוֹס יָת חַטָּאתָא וְיָת עֲלָתָא בַּאֲתַר קַדִּישׁ
e: He shall slaughter the lamb in the place where he slaughters the sin-offering and the burnt-offering, in the sacred place;
for, just as the sin-offering — is the guilt-offering; it belongs to the kohein,
it is most holy.
The kohein shall take from the blood of the guilt-offering
and the kohein shall put
it on the middle ridge [upper part] of the right ear of the person being purified,
and on the thumb of his right hand
and on the big toe of his right foot.
The kohein shall take from the log of the oil
and he shall pour it onto the koheins left palm.

h: וְהִזָּ֨ה מִן־הַשֶּׁ֧מֶן בְּאֶצְבָּע֛וֹ שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
t: מִן מִשְׁחָא דִּי עַל יְדֵיהּ דִּשְׂמָאלָא
וְיַדִּי מִן מִשְׁחָא בְּאֶצְבְּעֵיהּ שְׁבַע זִמְנִין קֳדָם יְיָ:
e: The kohein shall immerse his right finger in some
of the oil that is on his left palm
and he shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before Adonoy.

h: וּמִיֶּ֨תֶר הַשֶּׁ֜מֶן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־כַּפּ֗וֹ יִתֵּ֤ן הַכֹּהֵן֙ עַל־תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית
t: וּמִשְּׁאָר מִשְׁחָא דִּי עַל יְדֵיהּ יִתֵּן כַּהֲנָא עַל רוּם אוּדְנָא דְּמִדַּכֵּי דְּיַמִּינָא
e: From the remaining oil that is on his palm, the kohein shall put on the middle ridge [upper part] of the right ear of the person being purified,
and on the thumb of his right hand,
and on the big toe of his right foot;
on [over] the blood of the guilt-offering.

t: וּדְאִשְׁתָּאַר בְּמִשְׁחָא דִּי עַל יְדָא דְכַהֲנָא
e: Whatever oil remains that is on the palm of the kohein,
he shall put on the head of the person undergoing purification.
The kohein will atone for him before Adonoy.
The kohein shall do (offer) the sin-offering
and atone for the person undergoing purification from his impurity
and afterwards he shall slaughter the burnt-offering.

t: וְיַסֵּק כַּהֲנָא יָת עֲלָתָא וְיָת מִנְחָתָא לְמַדְבְּחָא
e: The kohein shall raise up the burnt-offering and the meal-offering onto the altar
and the kohein will atone for him and he will be purified.

h: וְ֠לָקַח כֶּ֣בֶשׂ אֶחָ֥ד אָשָׁ֛ם לִתְנוּפָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו
וְעִשָּׂר֨וֹן סֹ֜לֶת אֶחָ֨ד בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶן לְמִנְחָ֖ה וְלֹ֥ג שָֽׁמֶן׃
t: וְאִם מִסְכֵּן הוּא וְלֵית יְדֵיהּ מַדְבְּקָא
וְיִסַּב אִמַּר חַד אֲשָׁמָא לַאֲרָמָא לְכַפָּרָא עֲלוֹהִי
וְעִסְרוֹנָא סֻלְתָּא חַד דְּפִיל בִּמְשַׁח לְמִנְחָא וְלֻגָּא דְמִשְׁחָא:
e: If he is poor and his means are not sufficient,
he shall take one lamb as a guilt-offering, for a wave-offering [an uplifted offering] to atone for him
and one tenth fine flour mixed with oil, as a meal-offering and a log of oil.

h: וּשְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה
t: וְתַרְתֵּין שַׁפְנִינִין אוֹ תְרֵין בְּנֵי יוֹנָה
e: And two turtledoves or two young pigeons
such as his means suffice.
One shall be for a sin-offering
and one shall be for a burnt-offering.

h: וְהֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜ם בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֛י לְטָהֳרָת֖וֹ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֑ן
t: וְיַיְתִי יָתְהוֹן בְּיוֹמָא תְמִינָאָה לְדַכָּיוּתֵיהּ לְוָת כַּהֲנָא
e: He shall bring them on the eighth day of his purification, to the kohein,
to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, before Adonoy.

h: וְלָקַ֧ח הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־כֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת־לֹ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן
וְהֵנִ֨יף אֹתָ֧ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
t: וְיִסַּב כַּהֲנָא יָת אִמְּרָא דַאֲשָׁמָא וְיָת לֻגָּא דְמִשְׁחָא
e: The kohein shall take the guilt-offering sheep and the log of oil
and the kohein shall wave [lift] them [up] as a wave-offering [an uplifted offering] before Adonoy.
He shall slaughter the guilt-offering lamb.
The kohein shall take some blood of the guilt-offering
and put it on the middle ridge [upper part] of the right ear of the person undergoing purification,
and on the thumb of his right hand
and the big toe of his right foot.
The kohein shall pour some of the oil
onto the koheins left palm.

t: מִן מִשְׁחָא דִּי עַל יְדֵיהּ דִּשְׂמָאלָא
e: The kohein shall sprinkle, with his right finger,
some of the oil that is on his left palm,
seven times before Adonoy.

h: וְנָתַ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִן־הַשֶּׁ֣מֶן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־כַּפּ֗וֹ עַל־תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית
t: וְיִתֵּן כַּהֲנָא מִן מִשְׁחָא דִּי עַל יְדֵיהּ עַל רוּם אוּדְנָא דְמִדַּכֵּי דְּיַמִּינָא
e: The kohein shall put some of the oil that is on his palm, on the middle ridge [upper part] of the right ear of the person undergoing purification,
and on the thumb of his right hand
and on the big toe of his right foot,
on the place of the blood of the guilt-offering.

t: וּדְיִשְׁתָּאַר מִן מִשְׁחָא דִּי עַל יְדָא דְכַהֲנָא
e: What remains of the oil that is on the palm of the kohein,
he shall put on the head of the person undergoing purification,
to achieve his atonement before Adonoy.
He shall do (offer) one of the turtledoves
or of the young pigeons,
from that which his means suffice,

h: אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־תַּשִּׂ֞יג יָד֗וֹ אֶת־הָאֶחָ֥ד חַטָּ֛את וְאֶת־הָאֶחָ֥ד עֹלָ֖ה עַל־הַמִּנְחָ֑ה
וְכִפֶּ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן עַ֥ל הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
t: יָת דִּי תַדְבֵּק יְדֵיהּ יָת חַד חַטָּאתָא וְיָת חַד עֲלָתָא עַל מִנְחָתָא
וִיכַפֵּר כַּהֲנָא עַל דְּמִדַּכֵּי קֳדָם יְיָ:
e: that for which his means are sufficient, one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering with the meal-offering.
The kohein will atone for the person undergoing purification before Adonoy.
This is the law
of whoever has the skin-eruption of tzoraas [’confinement’]
whose means are not sufficient in his purification.
Adonoy spoke
to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:
When you will come into the land of Canaan
that I will give to you for a possession,
and I shall put the eruption of tzoraas [’confinement’]
in the house of the land of your possession.
Whoevers house it is, shall come
and tell to the kohein, saying,
Something like an eruption has appeared to me in the house.

h: וְצִוָּ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וּפִנּ֣וּ אֶת־הַבַּ֗יִת בְּטֶ֨רֶם יָבֹ֤א הַכֹּהֵן֙ לִרְא֣וֹת אֶת־הַנֶּ֔גַע
וְאַ֥חַר כֵּ֛ן יָבֹ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־הַבָּֽיִת׃
t: וִיפַקֵּד כַּהֲנָא וִיפַנּוּן יָת בֵּיתָא עַד לָא יֵעוֹל כַּהֲנָא לְמֶחֱזֵי יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא
וּבָתַר כֵּן יֵעוֹל כַּהֲנָא לְמֶחֱזֵי יָת בֵּיתָא:
e: The kohein shall command, and they shall empty the house [of its contents] before the kohein will come to see the eruption
so everything in the house shall not become impure.
Afterwards, the kohein shall come to see the house.

h: וְרָאָ֣ה אֶת־הַנֶּ֗גַע וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בְּקִירֹ֣ת הַבַּ֔יִת
t: וְיֶחֱזֵי יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא וְהָא מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּכָתְלֵי בֵיתָא
e: He shall see the eruption and behold! The eruption is in the walls of the house;
impressions, of greenest green
or of reddest red [green or red]
and they appear to be lower than the [surface of] the wall.

t: וְיִפּוֹק כַּהֲנָא מִן בֵּיתָא לִתְרַע בֵּיתָא
e: The kohein shall go out of the house to the entrance of the house,
and place the house under quarantine for seven days.

h: וְרָאָ֕ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בְּקִירֹ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת׃
e: The kohein shall return on the seventh day
and shall see; and behold! the eruption has spread [increased] in the walls of the house.
The kohein shall command
and they shall remove the stones
in which there is the eruption
and cast them away, beyond the city
to an impure place.

t: וְיָת בֵּיתָא יְקַלְּפוּן מִגָּיו סְחוֹר סְחוֹר
e: He shall scrape the house from the inside, all around,
and they shall throw away the earth that they scraped,
beyond the city,
to an impure place.

t: וַעֲפַר אָחֳרָן יִסַּב וִישׁוּעַ יָת בֵּיתָא:
e: They shall take other stones,
and they shall bring them to replace the stones,
and he shall take other earth and plaster the house.

t: וּבָתַר דְקַלִּיפוּ יָת בֵּיתָא וּבָתַר דְּאִתְּשָׁע:
e: If the eruption returns and sprouts in the house
after the stones were removed,
and after the house was scraped, and after it was plastered,

h: צָרַ֨עַת מַמְאֶ֥רֶת הִ֛וא בַּבַּ֖יִת טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
e: the kohein shall come and see;
and behold! the eruption has spread [increased] in the house;
prickly tzoraas [’confinement’ of loss] is in the house, it is impure.

t: וִיתָרַע יָת בֵּיתָא יָת אַבְנוֹהִי וְיָת אָעוֹהִי
e: He shall dismantle the house; its stones and its wood
and all the earth of the house.
He shall take it out beyond the city,
to an impure place.
Whoever will come inside the house
[during] all the days of its confinement,
shall be impure until the evening.
Whoever will lie down inside the house
shall wash his garments.
Whoever will eat inside the house
shall wash his garments.

h: וְאִם־בֹּ֨א יָבֹ֜א הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְרָאָה֙ וְ֠הִנֵּה לֹא־פָשָׂ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת
t: וְאִם מֵעַל יֵיעוֹל כַּהֲנָא וְיֶחֱזֵי וְהָא לָא אוֹסֵף מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּבֵיתָא
e: If the kohein shall come and see; and behold! the eruption did not spread [increase] in the house
after the house was plastered,
the kohein shall pronounce the house [to be] pure,
for the eruption has been healed.

t: וְיִסַּב לְדַכָּאָה יָת בֵּיתָא תַּרְתֵּין צִפְּרִין
e: He shall take, to purify the house, two birds,
cedar wood,
crimson [colored] thread and hyssop.
He shall slaughter one bird
in an earthenware vessel, over running water.

h: וְלָקַ֣ח אֶת־עֵֽץ־הָ֠אֶרֶז וְאֶת־הָ֨אֵזֹ֜ב וְאֵ֣ת שְׁנִ֣י הַתּוֹלַ֗עַת וְאֵת֮ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽחַיָּה֒
t: וְיִסַּב יָת אָעָא דְאַרְזָא וְיָת אֵזוֹבָא וְיָת צְבַע זְהוֹרִי וְיָת צִפֲּרָא חַיְתָא
e: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the crimson [colored] thread and the live bird
and immerse them in the blood of the slaughtered bird
and in the running water,
and sprinkle the house seven times.

h: וּבַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַחַיָּ֗ה וּבְעֵ֥ץ הָאֶ֛רֶז וּבָאֵזֹ֖ב וּבִשְׁנִ֥י הַתּוֹלָֽעַת׃
t: וּבְצִפֲּרָא חַיְתָא וּבְאָעָא דְאַרְזָא וּבְאֵזוֹבָא וּבִצְבַע זְהוֹרִי:
e: He shall purify the house
with the blood of the bird,
and with the running water,
and with the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop and the crimson [colored] thread.

h: וְשִׁלַּ֞ח אֶת־הַצִּפֹּ֧ר הַֽחַיָּ֛ה אֶל־מִח֥וּץ לָעִ֖יר אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה
t: וִישַׁלַּח יָת צִפֲּרָא חַיְתָא לְמִבָּרָא לְקַרְתָּא לְאַפֵּי חַקְלָא
e: He shall send the living bird, beyond the city into the open field,
and atone for the house and it shall be purified.
This is the law
for all the eruptions of tzoraas [’confinement’] and for the nesek.
For tzoraas [’confinement’] of the garment and of the house.
For the spot [deeply] white as wool, for the spot that is nearly as white and for the spot white as snow.
To teach [the law] of the day of becoming impure and of the day of becoming pure;
this is the law of tzoraas [’confinement’].
Adonoy spoke
to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:

h: אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ כִּ֤י יִהְיֶה֙ זָ֣ב מִבְּשָׂר֔וֹ
t: גְּבַר גְּבַר אֲרֵי יְהֵי דָּאִיב מִבִּשְׂרֵיהּ
e: Speak to Bnei Yisroel
and say to them;
should [discharge] flow from the body of any man,
[because of] his discharge, he is impure.

h: רָ֣ר בְּשָׂר֞וֹ אֶת־זוֹב֗וֹ אֽוֹ־הֶחְתִּ֤ים בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ
t: רָר בִּשְׂרֵיהּ יָת דּוֹבֵיהּ אוֹ חָתִים בִּשְׂרֵיהּ מִדּוֹבֵיהּ
e: This is the law of his impurity, when his discharge flows;
His flesh drips [with] his discharge or his flesh is stopped up by his discharge,
it causes him to become impure.

h: כָּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָ֑א
t: כָּל מִשְׁכְּבָא דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב עֲלוֹהִי דּוֹבָנָא יְהֵי מְסָאָב
וְכָל מָנָא דְיֵיתֵב עֲלוֹהִי יְהֵי מְסָאָב:
e: Every bed [Anything that is used specifically for sleeping], upon which will lie a zov [a person from whom a discharge flows,] shall become impure.
Every vessel upon which he sits, shall become impure.

h: יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
t: יְצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיַסְחֵי בְמַיָּא וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: A person who touches his bed
shall wash his garments and bathe in water and is impure until the evening.

h: יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
t: יְצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיַסְחֵי בְמַיָּא וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: Whoever sits on the vessel
that was sat upon by a zov
shall wash his garments and bathe in water and is impure until the evening.

h: יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
t: יְצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיַסְחֵי בְמַיָּא וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: Whoever touches the flesh of a zov
shall wash his garments and bathe in water and is impure until the evening.

h: וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
t: וִיצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיַסְחֵי בְמַיָּא וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: If the zov spits on a ritually clean person,
he shall wash his garments and bathe in water and is impure until the evening.

h: וְכָל־הַמֶּרְכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָֽא׃
t: וְכָל מֶרְכְּבָא דִּי יִרְכּוּב עֲלוֹהִי דּוֹבָנָא יְהֵי מְסָאָב:
e: Anything that is used for riding upon which a zov will ride shall become impure.

h: יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
t: וְכָל דְּיִקְרַב בְּכֹל דִּי יְהֵי תְחוֹתוֹהִי
יְצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיַסְחֵי בְמַיָּא וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: Anyone who touches anything which is beneath him
shall be impure until the evening.
and whoever carries them
shall wash his garments and bathe in water and is impure until the evening.

h: וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
t: וִיצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיַסְחֵי בְמַיָּא וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: If a zov touches anyone
and his hands were not rinsed in water,
he shall wash his garments and bathe in water and is impure until the evening.

t: וּמַאן דַּחֲסַף דִּי יִקְרַב בֵּיהּ דּוֹבָנָא יִתָּבַר
e: An earthenware vessel which the zov will touch shall be broken.
Any wooden vessel shall be rinsed in water.

h: וְסָ֨פַר ל֜וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים לְטָהֳרָת֖וֹ וְכִבֶּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֑יו
t: וְיִמְנֵי לֵיהּ שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין לְדָכוּתֵיהּ וִיצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי
e: When a zov will become ritually clean, from his discharge-impurity,
he shall count for himself seven days for his purification and wash his garments,
and bathe in running water, and he will be purified.

h: וּבָ֣א לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־פֶּ֙תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד
t: וּבְיוֹמָא תְמִינָאָה יִסַּב לֵיהּ תַּרְתֵּין שַׁפְנִינִין
וְיֵיתֵי לָקֳדָם יְיָ לִתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא
e: On the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves
or two young pigeons
and come before Adonoy, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting
and give them to the kohein.

h: וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִזּוֹבֽוֹ׃
t: וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַּהֲנָא קֳדָם יְיָ מִדּוֹבֵיהּ:
e: The kohein shall do (offer) them,
one as a sin-offering
and the [other] one as a burnt-offering.
The kohein will atone for him before Adonoy, from his discharge-impurity.

t: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי תִפּוֹק מִנֵּיהּ שִׁכְבַת זַרְעָא
וְיַסְחֵי בְמַיָּא יָת כָּל בִּשְׂרֵיהּ וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: A man, if semen issues from him,
he shall bathe his entire body in water and is impure until the evening.

t: וְיִצְטַבַּע בְּמַיָּא וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: Any garment and any leather object
upon which there is semen
shall be washed in water and is impure until the evening.

h: וְאִשָּׁ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב אִ֛ישׁ אֹתָ֖הּ שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע
t: וְאִתְּתָא דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב גְּבַר יָתַהּ שִׁכְבַת זַרְעָא
e: A woman, with whom a man will lie conjugally;
they shall bathe in water,
and are impure until the evening.

t: וְכָל דְּיִקְרַב בַּהּ יְהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: When a woman has a discharge
[and] the discharge will be blood in her body,
for seven days she will be in [the state of] her menstrual impurity [’separation’].
Anyone who touches her will be impure until the evening.

h: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו בְּנִדָּתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֑א
t: וְכֹל דִּי תִשְׁכּוּב עֲלוֹהִי בְּרִחוּקַהּ יְהֵי מְסָאָב
וְכֹל דִּי תֵיתֵב עֲלוֹהִי יְהֵי מְסָאָב:
e: Everything that she sleeps on, during her menstrual impurity [’separation’], will become impure
and everything that she sits on will be impure.

h: יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
t: יְצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיַסְחֵי בְמַיָּא וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: Anyone who touches what she slept on,
shall wash his garments and bathe in water and is impure until the evening.

h: יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
t: וְכָל דְּיִקְרַב בְּכָל מָנָא דִּי תֵיתֵב עֲלוֹהִי
יְצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיַסְחֵי בְמַיָּא וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: Anyone who touches any vessel that she sits on,
shall wash his garments and bathe in water and is impure until the evening.

h: וְאִ֨ם עַֽל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֜ב ה֗וּא א֧וֹ עַֽל־הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־הִ֥וא יֹשֶֽׁבֶת־עָלָ֖יו בְּנָגְעוֹ־ב֑וֹ
t: וְאִם עַל מִשְׁכְּבָא הוּא אוֹ עַל מָנָא דִּי הִא יָתְבָא עֲלוֹהִי בְּמִקְרְבֵיהּ בֵּיהּ
e: If he is on the bed or on the vessel that she is sitting on, when he touches it,
he shall be impure until the evening.

h: וְאִ֡ם שָׁכֹב֩ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אִ֜ישׁ אֹתָ֗הּ וּתְהִ֤י נִדָּתָהּ֙ עָלָ֔יו
t: וְאִם מִשְׁכַּב יִשְׁכּוּב גְּבַר יָתַהּ וּתְהֵי רִחוּקַהּ עֲלוֹהִי
וְכָל מִשְׁכְּבָא דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב עֲלוֹהִי יְהֵי מְסָאָב:
e: If a man will lie conjugally with her, her menstrual impurity [’separation’] will be on him
and he is impure for seven days.
Anything used for sleeping — if he should sleep on it — it will be impure.

h: וְאִשָּׁ֡ה כִּֽי־יָזוּב֩ ז֨וֹב דָּמָ֜הּ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים בְּלֹא֙ עֶת־נִדָּתָ֔הּ
כָּל־יְמֵ֞י ז֣וֹב טֻמְאָתָ֗הּ כִּימֵ֧י נִדָּתָ֛הּ תִּהְיֶ֖ה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִֽוא׃
t: וְאִתְּתָא אֲרֵי יְדוּב דּוֹב דְּמַהּ יוֹמִין סַגִּיאִין בְּלָא עִדַּן רִחוּקַהּ
כָּל יוֹמֵי דּוֹב סוֹבְתַהּ כְּיוֹמֵיהּ רִחוּקַהּ תְּהֵי מְסָאֳבָא הִיא:
e: When a woman discharges her blood-flow, many days outside her menstrual cycle [period of ‘separation’],
or if it flows after her menstrual cycle [’separation’],
all the days of her discharge-impurity shall be as her days of menstrual impurity [’separation’]; she is impure.

t: כָּל מִשְׁכְּבָא דִּי תִשְׁכּוּב עֲלוֹהִי כָּל יוֹמֵי דוֹבַהּ
e: Anything used for sleeping upon which she will lie [on] any of her discharge-impurity-days,
as the bed of her menstrual impurity [’separation’] it shall be to her.
Every vessel upon which she sits
will be impure,
just as [is] her menstrual-impurity [the impurity of her ‘separation’].

h: וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
t: וִיצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיַסְחֵי בְמַיָּא וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא:
e: Anyone that touches them will be impure
and he shall wash his garments and bathe in water and is impure until the evening.

h: וְסָ֥פְרָה לָּ֛הּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְאַחַ֥ר תִּטְהָֽר׃
t: וְתִמְנֵי לַהּ שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין וּבָתַר כֵּן תִּדְכֵּי:
e: When she has become pure from her discharge-impurity,
she shall count seven days for herself and afterwards she becomes purified.

t: וּבְיוֹמָא תְמִינָאָה תִּסַּב לַהּ תַּרְתֵּין שַׁפְנִינִין
e: On the eighth day she shall take for herself, two turtledoves
or two young pigeons
and she shall bring them to the kohein,
to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
The kohein shall do (offer) one as a sin-offering
and the [other] one as a burnt-offering.
The kohein will atone for her before Adonoy
from her discharge-impurity.
You shall separate Bnei Yisroel from their impurities
and they will not die because of their impurities
through their defilement of My dwelling in their midst.

t: וְדִי תִפּוֹק מִנֵּיהּ שִׁכְבַת זַרְעָא לְאִסְתָּאָבָא בַהּ:
e: This is the law of the zov
and of him from whom semen issues to become impure through it.
For the menstruant [woman who is impure] during her period of separation
and for one who has a discharge
for a male and for a female;
and for the man that will lie conjugally with an impure woman.
